page: Amazon Web Services c8ine.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance running on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The instance delivers 8 dedicated vCPUs distributed across 4 physical cores with two threads per core, paired with 16.0 GB of system memory. This maintains a 1:2 core-to-memory allocation ratio typical of compute-focused platforms.

The c8ine.2xlarge configuration does not include bundled local storage disks and instead relies exclusively on remote EBS volumes for block storage. Hardware accelerators are absent, with zero GPUs attached to the instance. For external connectivity and distributed workloads, the instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Because the configuration allocates 2.0 GB of memory per core and includes no integrated scratch storage, it offers a focused profile tailored to pure CPU throughput over large memory caching. The resource distribution suits compute-bound workloads requiring consistent clock frequencies, including distributed batch processing, web serving, continuous integration pipelines, and computational analytics.
